name: Adhesive bonding
scene: An original compact adhesive lap-joint demonstrator: two brushed aluminium strips, ivory ceramic supports and a small amber-resin dispensing syringe. Three-quarter macro view, warm charcoal workshop, amber illumination. Entire syringe, both strips and fixture visible, ample edge margin. Not on a glass pedestal.
stages: Two clean strips separated and aligned for an overlapping joint; no resin yet.
A small amber resin bead deposited onto the lower strip while upper strip is raised.
Upper strip lowered into overlap, amber liquid resin visibly spreading into a thin continuous layer between surfaces; cutaway edge shows wetting.
Strips held overlapped by a small clamp while amber adhesive forms a solid polymer layer. No heat or UV source; room-temperature curing example.
Completed overlapped strips held at opposite ends with a thin cured adhesive layer transferring a modest tensile load; no separation or breaking.

name: Condensation
scene: A chilled matte blue vertical copper plate with serpentine coolant pipe behind, humid air flowing across its front and a small collecting trough. Freestanding educational thermal demonstration, dark navy studio, crisp silver water highlights, no generic glass base. Whole plate and trough visible.
stages: Warm humid air approaches the initially dry cold plate; no visible droplets yet. Water vapour itself is invisible.
Small isolated water droplets nucleate on the cooled surface.
Many distinct droplets grow on the chilled plate, blue coolant visible in rear pipe.
Larger droplets merge into rivulets down the plate.
Condensate collects in the trough beneath the plate; some droplets remain on the surface.

name: Acoustic levitation
scene: Two opposed circular arrays of small ultrasonic transducers facing vertically across an open gap on a slim curved black support. A tiny polystyrene bead near the central gap. Dark indigo background and cyan conceptual pressure-field ripples. Entire apparatus in view, distinct from a single-horn liquid tank.
stages: Lower transducer array emitting faint upward conceptual wavefronts, bead resting on a slim loading probe.
Opposed array produces counterpropagating waves in the air gap, loading probe still present.
Standing-wave structure shown as alternating subtle cyan pressure bands in the gap. Bead is just entering a stable trapping location.
Small bead suspended without touching either array, loading probe withdrawn, waves visible.
Three small separated beads stably levitated at successive trapping locations between the arrays. Keep array identity and camera identical.

name: Amphiphiles
scene: Elegant scientific molecular-scale cutaway of an amber oil droplet in turquoise water. Amphiphilic molecules drawn as single cyan spherical hydrophilic heads with single amber flexible hydrocarbon tails, physically clear ball-and-chain models. Dark petrol background, luminous yet restrained molecular visual, no laboratory machine or glass pedestal. Not literal atom counts.
stages: Several separated amphiphile molecules in water near a large amber oil droplet, heads and tails clearly distinguishable.
Molecules gathering at water-oil interface, cyan heads face water and amber tails penetrate oil.
Droplet fully coated with amphiphiles, tails inward in oil, cyan heads outward in water.
A spherical micelle cutaway in water with tails packed inward and hydrophilic heads outward; clearly distinguish oil droplet from molecular micelle.
Several small amphiphile-coated oil droplets dispersed in water, separated rather than merging; a representative coated droplet enlarged centrally.

name: Electrodeposition
scene: Compact electroplating teaching bath with a copper plate on left and a hanging steel spoon cathode on right immersed in transparent blue copper-ion electrolyte, DC source behind and correctly connected leads. Dark cobalt chemistry bench. Complete electrodes and bath visible, macro cutaway access to spoon surface.
stages: Copper plate and bare silver steel spoon immersed in blue electrolyte, power off.
DC source on; copper anode left and steel cathode right, subtle conceptual ion motion through electrolyte toward spoon.
Magnified spoon edge shows copper ions arriving and gaining electrons, first small copper nuclei on steel. No letters or symbols.
Thin copper deposit growing evenly on submerged spoon while copper anode remains present.
Spoon lifted slightly above solution showing continuous warm copper coating with blue droplets draining into bath.

name: Electrostatic induction
scene: Polished isolated metal sphere on amber insulating stalk, a negatively charged purple rod approaching from left and a separate removable grounding lead at right. Dark burgundy physics bench. Conceptual blue negative charges and orange positive background represented by tiny coloured particles without plus/minus symbols; complete apparatus visible.
stages: Charged rod far from initially neutral metal sphere, blue and orange indicators balanced.
Rod close but not touching sphere; blue mobile electrons shifted to far right, orange positive excess on near left.
Rod remains near sphere while grounding lead contacts right side, excess blue electrons moving away through lead.
Grounding lead disconnected while charged rod still near, net positive sphere with orange excess indicators.
Rod withdrawn, isolated positively charged sphere with orange excess spread around outer surface; no grounding contact.

name: Distillation
scene: Beautiful compact borosilicate distillation setup: round flask with violet liquid on ceramic heating mantle at lower left, rising neck then sloped water-jacket condenser descending to receiving flask at lower right. Proper clamps, dark plum chemistry studio, complete functional glass path visible. Coolant enters lower condenser port and leaves upper port; no text.
stages: Mixed liquid in boiling flask, receiving flask empty, heating mantle off.
Gentle boiling in source flask with bubbles, heat supplied by mantle; receiving flask nearly empty.
Vapour passes through upper connecting neck into condenser; vapor indicated subtly, not solid liquid in tube.
Clear condensate droplets form within cooled sloping condenser and flow toward receiver.
Receiver contains collected clear distillate while violet residue remains in boiling flask; both visible.

name: Photoionisation
scene: Scientific conceptual cutaway of a single neutral atom in a dark violet gas chamber with a narrow violet ultraviolet beam entering from left and a compact charge collector to right. Central translucent electron cloud and bright nucleus, electron depicted as tiny cyan particle. Elegant quantum teaching illustration, electron cloud not classical solid orbital track. Entire conceptual scene visible.
stages: Neutral atom with electron cloud, UV source at left not yet emitting.
Single incoming photon visualized as a short violet wave packet approaching atom.
Photon absorbed by atom, concentrated interaction glow in electron cloud, electron beginning to leave.
Freed cyan electron clearly separated from residual positive ion and travelling toward collector.
Positive ion remains and electron reaches collector, visual separation of particles after ionisation. No extra electrons created.

name: Creaming
scene: Tall transparent cylindrical emulsion sample vessel on a simple cream ceramic bench, pale turquoise continuous water phase with distinct small amber oil droplets. Dark teal background. Scientific cutaway visual with magnified visible droplets, not literal size. Entire vessel in view, no machinery or glass pedestal.
stages: Oil droplets distributed uniformly throughout emulsion, no surface layer.
Less-dense oil droplets begin rising through water under buoyancy, individual droplets stay separate.
More droplets accumulate in upper region, lower region becomes clearer; no droplet fusion.
Concentrated cream layer of many distinct droplets at top and clearer serum beneath.
Gently remixed emulsion with separate droplets redistributed, showing reversible creaming rather than irreversible coalescence.

name: Bingham plastic
scene: Conceptual rheometer with two parallel circular plates and a thick orange paste disk between them, lower plate fixed to small matte charcoal pedestal and upper plate coupled to a torque head. Side macro view revealing shear deformation. Dark burnt-orange studio, not glass base, complete apparatus.
stages: Paste disk at rest between parallel plates, undeformed shape.
Small applied torque, paste largely retains shape below yield stress, upper plate barely displaced.
Torque reaches yielding condition, paste begins sustained shearing at rim.
Upper plate rotating, paste clearly shearing as smooth concentric deformation between plates, steady post-yield flow.
Torque removed, paste at rest again retaining new shape; ideal yield-stress demonstration, not elastic springback.

name: Aerogel insulation
scene: Translucent pale-blue silica aerogel tile held between a warm orange metal block below and a cool silver cap above. Large adjacent magnified inset-like porous nanostructure integrated into dark navy scene, airy silica struts and abundant pores. Scientific conceptual thermal demonstration, no bare flames or unsafe hand contact, whole tile and blocks visible.
stages: Aerogel tile between two unheated plates, airy nanoporous texture visible.
Lower plate heated orange; upper plate stays relatively cool blue, tile intact.
Close conceptual cutaway shows sparse connected silica struts limiting solid conduction through aerogel.
Magnified nanoscale pores show confined gas particles with limited travel distance, whole apparatus still visible.
Stable temperature difference across tile with warm lower plate and cooler upper cap. Not perfect insulation and no absolute zero heat flow.

name: Cathodic arc evaporation
scene: Cutaway compact vacuum deposition chamber with circular titanium cathode at lower left and substrate holder upper right, matte brushed steel enclosure partly removed for visibility. Dark purple industrial laboratory, violet plasma glow. Entire chamber and both target and substrate in frame, scientific conceptual setup not a product blueprint.
stages: Vacuum chamber with titanium cathode and uncoated substrate, discharge off.
Small intensely bright cathode spot ignites on titanium surface inside vacuum chamber.
Violet metal plasma plume expands from cathode toward substrate, source spot localized.
Metal ions arrive at substrate and form small deposition nuclei, plasma still visible.
Continuous thin metallic film on substrate, cathode and vacuum chamber unchanged; faint residual plasma and occasional sparse droplets allowed.

name: Activated alumina adsorption
scene: Transparent vertical packed drying column filled with white porous activated-alumina beads, moist air inlet at lower left and dry air outlet at upper right. Small humidity sensor outside, dark slate setting. A large cutaway bead shows internal pores with tiny cyan water molecules as conceptual particles, complete column visible.
stages: Fresh white porous alumina beads fill column, moist-air inlet approaching.
Moist air enters bed, tiny blue water particles move toward beads.
Magnified white bead shows water adsorbed on internal pore surfaces, not absorbed into a solid core.
Dryer outlet air with fewer water particles; adsorption front has progressed upward through bed.
Warm dry purge removes adsorbed water from beads during regeneration; separated water vapour exits outlet, bead structure preserved.

name: Lorentz force
scene: Educational charged-particle beam chamber in a dark navy magnetic field rig. A fine cyan beam emitted from a small electron gun at left curves through central field between two large copper coils visible behind. Complete coils and glowing beam within scene, no labels. Conceptual visible beam trajectory represents electrons in a low pressure gas, not a solid wire.
stages: Electron gun emits straight thin beam with magnetic field off, coils unpowered.
Copper coils energized, beam starts bending through uniform central magnetic field.
Smooth circular electron trajectory in central field, force perpendicular to instantaneous velocity.
Stronger magnetic field gives smaller circular trajectory at same electron speed, same gun and coils.
Reversed field reverses curvature direction at same speed, same setup and framing.

name: Ferromagnetism
scene: A dark iron bar partly inside a copper solenoid, with a large crisp cutaway window revealing patchwork magnetic domains represented by aligned tiny arrow-shaped dipoles without letters. Dark graphite laboratory and crimson/cyan magnetic accents. Whole bar and coil visible, domain illustration clearly microscopic conceptual inset not literal surface markings.
stages: Unmagnetized iron bar, domain patches point in different directions, coil off.
External field applied by coil; domains already aligned with field begin to grow at neighbours expense.
Most domains aligned under strong field, iron strongly magnetized, coil energized.
Coil switched off and some alignment remains, demonstrating remanence in a hysteretic ferromagnet.
Reversed coil current, domains turn toward opposite direction, demonstrating magnetic reversal rather than permanent fixed direction.

name: Doppler effect
scene: Small orange moving loudspeaker cart on a horizontal laboratory rail with a stationary cyan microphone at right. Conceptual translucent sound wavefronts in air, dark midnight blue setting. Whole cart, rail and microphone visible, three-quarter elevated view, wave spacing scientifically clear, no labels.
stages: Loudspeaker stationary, equally spaced concentric sound wavefronts around it, microphone right.
Loudspeaker cart moving right toward microphone, wavefronts compressed ahead and spread behind.
Speaker approaching microphone, short spacing ahead clearly visible, same emission frequency.
Speaker has passed microphone and moves away right, stretched wavefront spacing reaching microphone behind.
Speaker stopped again, new wavefronts equally spaced while older ones spread away, stationary microphone unchanged.

name: Activated carbon adsorption
scene: Cutaway compact water filter cartridge filled with irregular matte-black activated carbon granules, amber contaminant particles in inlet water and clearer turquoise outlet. Large magnified charcoal grain revealing tortuous internal micropores at right. Dark teal environment, complete cartridge visible, conceptual particle scale not literal, no generic glass pedestal.
stages: Fresh carbon granules with open micropores, water containing amber solute molecules approaches inlet.
Water flows between grains, dissolved amber molecules transported to grain surfaces.
Magnified micropores show amber molecules attached to internal carbon surfaces, not simply mechanically sieved between grains.
Cleaner water exits but some dissolved contaminants can remain, adsorption sites progressively occupied.
Saturated bed with occupied sites allows more amber molecules into outlet, representing breakthrough and need for replacement or controlled regeneration.
